nom: I Dew Care Chill Mo-Mint Soothing & Cooling Wash-Off Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily concerns noted the mask reduced pores and oiliness after use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask hydrates without stripping, softens dry patches, and leaves dry areas feeling moisturized and soothed.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and a soothing, non-stinging experience, though one warns the peppermint oil can be irritating for sensitive skin and another found it not recommended for sensitive skin due to intensity.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s with rosacea-prone, drier mature skin uses it a few times a month as a favorite summer clay mask that tightens pores without over-drying.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing normal, rosacea-affected skin finds it a favorite summer mask that cleans pores and tightens skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describing themselves as older or mature report the mask keeps skin looking youthful and refreshed, with one long-term user (40, rosacea) treating it as a gentle seasonal treat rather than a heavy treatment.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers, including those specifying dry skin, report the mask hydrates, softens dry patches, and leaves skin moisturized rather than tight; no reports of increased dryness.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers with rosacea or redness report the cooling effect calms flare-ups and reduces visible redness; no dissent found.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry, irritated skin reports reduced redness and inflammation with no side effects; no reports of barrier damage or stinging beyond initial application.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne-irritated skin reports the mask soothes but does not clear or cure acne; no other acne-specific reports.
concerns.blemishes: A single reviewer notes it helps clear and even out complexion, but this is not corroborated by other acne/blemish-focused reviewers.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the mask reduces the appearance of pores and oiliness; no other oiliness-specific feedback.

aspects.libelle: Cute, giftable jar packaging with spatula

extraits.texte: I have normal, 40 year old, type 1 rosacea skin and this is my favorite clay mask for summer! I don't use clay masks as often now that I'm older and my skin is dryer, but about 2-3 times a month really keeps my pores cleaned out and my skin tight. This smells like mint ice cream without the sweetness and is SUPER cooling. After a hot sweaty day or if I'm having a flush, this feels amazing. Be careful if you are sensitive as this doesn't just have peppermint leaf in it but it also has peppermint oil, which can be irritating for people with sensitive skin. But my skin doesn't mind it and this mask is perfect for me!

I really enjoyed this mask. It is not drying, and the exfoliants (walnut shells) are not harsh. I love using this mask to soothe my acne-irritated skin. It is super relaxing with the cooling sensation, and it smells SO good! I think I noticed a slight improvement of my skin after using it. It doesn't cure my acne, but really soothes the skin. I would consider buying this again.

I love the bliss mint chip mania facial mask but they don't see it anymore and I've been trying to find a mask that would give that minty refreshing feeling and this is it! It comes with a small spatula for application and the mask itself has tiny little exfoliators. I would not recommend for sensitive skin as the minty feeling might be overwhelming but I really enjoy it. It says that this is not a mask that will dry so to only leave on for 5-10 minutes.

I have dry Irritated skin that needs a constant care that's reason I want to find skincare products that could reduce my concern. I found this mask and tried If It could help. after some time I found that It could hydrate my skin and reduce redness and inflammation without any side effects. It also has great cooling effect and amazing scent I like. complimentary from brand for my honest opinion.

This mask is so refreshing. It truly does smell like mint ice cream. The packaging is adorable and recyclable. The mask is ideal for my skin type and helps to keep my dry areas hydrated. It doesn't cause any breakouts either. This product feels even more cooling after keeping it in the fridge. I love doing self care nights at home and this is my new favorite mask. Gifted by idewcare.

This mask is the perfect solution for my rosacea flare ups. It has a cooling effect on the skin which helps my redness calm down. It also smells like mint chocolate chip ice cream, which is an absolute treat! Takes me back to my childhood. My skin feels refreshed and rejuvenated after using this mask, I highly recommend it! It's the perfect "self care day" activity. I was gifted by idewcare and it is now part of my skincare routine!

The Mint Smooth Mask is amazing! It leaves my skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and deeply cleansed. The minty cooling effect is invigorating, and it effectively reduces pores and oiliness. Highly recommend for a rejuvenating skincare treat! Gifted by idewcare
